title: Phase 2 - Configuration - communication data sab-object validation

storage.value:
none

User story

As a system user

I would like to be able to manage, the possibility to add the communication data without email address or phone number to the list of objects, per instance.

So, the features of the instances match the needs of the corresponding company's customers.

the objects could be created for the customers, that have no email addresses and phone numbers.


As is process

In the current process, it is impossible to add a communication data that does not include at least one phone number and email address to a list of objects.


New process

Given that in the EPRs some of the customers may not have a phone number and email address (they only have a physical address), the user should have the ability to change the validation logic in respective instance settings and to create contracts with a communication data that does not include an email address and phone number.

This should be possible from the instance configuration page (please check the story Configuration page )



Acceptance criteria

Configuration option 1

To the objects listed below, do not allow adding the communication data in a “communication data” sub object without email address or/and phone number in it.

Configuration option 2

To the objects listed below, allow adding the communication data in a “communication data” sub object without email address or/and phone number in it.

List of processes and objects where the communication data is added in a sub object

  1. Product contract

  2. Service contract

  3. Express Contract

  4. Service Order

  5. Goods Order

  6. Billing run > manual invoice (sub object name: Invoice communication data)

  7. Billing run > Manual interim and advance payment (sub object name: Invoice communication data)

  8. Rescheduling (sub object name: Communication data for billing, Communication data for contract)

  9. Manual liability offsetting (Communication data for billing)

10.  Customer communication (sms) (Communication data)

11. Customer communication (email) (Communication data)


Configuration versioning check

When editing the above objects, communication data sub-object validation should work according to the settings of the configuration version in which the object was created (and not according to the configuration settings at the time of editing).

When comparing the object's creation timestamp with the configuration version period, the system must consider not only the date but also the exact time, with minute-level precision.

Example:

Config version 1: Valid until 01.01.2027 – No attributes mandatory

Config version 2: Valid from 01.01.2027 – E-Mail mandatory

Communication data A: Created without data for E-Mail or Phone on 15.12.2026

Current date: 12.01.2027

  • Communication data A exists and is valid without any attributes. On edit, the user is not forced to enter any attributes.

  • Communication data B is created – the user must enter E-mal to successfully create it

 

Exceptions/Additional notes

  • The “customer phone number” field on single sms object shouldn’t be affected by the configuration settings. which means “customer phone number” should always be mandatory.

  • The “customer e-mail address” field on single email object shouldn’t be affected by the configuration settings. which means “customer e-mail address” should always be mandatory.

  • For single sms object the email address should never be mandatory in the communication data (even if on the configuration page the “email” is checked as mandatory).

    • E.g: in the configuration settings “email” is checked as mandatory

    • Customer N1 doesn’t have the email address in communication data N1.

    • Customer N1 is added on the single sms object by user > Communication data N1 is automatically added in the sub-object.

  • For single email object the phone number should never be mandatory in the communication data (even if on the configuration page the “email” is checked as mandatory).

    • E.g: in the configuration settings “sms” is checked as mandatory

    • Customer N1 doesn’t have the phone number in communication data N1.

    • Customer N1 is added on the single email object by user > Communication data N1 is automatically added in the sub-object.

       

Preconditions

permission

The user should have the permission to change the configuration settings.

Set the configuration

The communication data validation should be set on system settings>configuration page.
